title: 分析化学
subtitle: Analytical Chemistry
educationalGoal: After completing this course, you will be able to : 1. Perform calculations for molar mass and molarity using titration data. 2. Perform calculations involving molar solubility and solubility product constant. 3. Describe complexation titrations using the Lewis concept of acids and bases. 4. Systematically balance oxidation-reduction reactions
advice: Analytical Chemistry is a foundation course for School of Applied Chemistry, also highly related to Laboratory course on sophomore and junior, and also senior capstone-course (Project Design III). The course is designed to help build a foundation of Analytical Chemistry, Acid-Base titration, Chelatometric titration, and Redox Titration. Through the course, the foundations of this titration method will be described from the view of gravimetric analysis. At the end of the course, you can solve single answer problems using these foundations.
books: Textbooks: Yu Kimura and Riichiro Nakamura (1996), Foundation of Analytical Chemistry, in Japanese Reference Books: not applicable Reserved Books in the Library: not applicable
requiredKnowledge: General knowledge of inorganic chemistry, organic chemistry, physics, and math are required.

activityGoals.body: You will be able to describe the foundation of acid-base titrations.
You will be able to explain the gravimetric analysis.
You will be able to describe Chelatometric titrations
You will be able to explain redox titration.

achievementLevels.ideal: At the conclusion of this course, you will be able to: - Perform titration calculations for given reactions. - Describe factors that affect the gravimetric analysis. - Solve complex problems using the foundations of titrations. - Simulate a precipitate formation for given conditions.
achievementLevels.standard: At the conclusion of this course, you will be able to: - Perform titration calculations for given reactions. - List factors that affect gravimetric analysis. - Solve simple problems using the foundations of titrations.

Readings Section 1, Chapter 1.2-1.4 Solve Section 1 Problem set 1.1-1.6
Readings Section 2, Chapter 2.1-2.4 Solve Section 2 Problem set 2.1-2.8, except 2.6.

lessons.content: 1st Exam Acid-base titration (1) - Definition of acids and bases - Equilibrium of electrolytic dissociation
lessons.assignments: Readings Section 2, Chapter 2.5-2.6 Solve Section 2 Problem set 2.9-2.10.

lessons.content: Acid-base titration (2) - Titration curve for weak acid and strong base - Titration curve for strong acid and weak base
lessons.assignments: Readings Section 2, Chapter 2.5-2.6 Solve Section 2 Problem set 2.9-2.10.

lessons.content: Acid-base titration (3) - Salt Hydrolysis - pH and electrolysis - Structure and reactions of pH indicator
lessons.assignments: Readings Section 2, Chapter 2.5-2.6 Solve Section 2 Problem set 2.9-2.10.
Readings Section 2, Chapter 2.7-2.10 Solve Section 2 Problem set 2.11-2.14, except 2.12.

lessons.content: Precipitation (1) - Dynamics of precipitation. - Molar solubility and solubility product constant.
lessons.assignments: Readings Section 2, Chapter 2.11 Wrap up problem sets for week 4 through 6.

lessons.content: Precipitation (2) - Effect of pH on the formation processes of Hydroxide precipitate and Sulfide precipitate.
lessons.assignments: Readings Section 3, Chapter 3.1-3.3 Solve Section 3 Problem set 3.1-3.4.
Readings Section 3, Chapter 3.4-3.8 Solve Section 3 Problem set 3.5-3.9.

lessons.content: Chelatometric titration (1) - Chelates and chelating agents - Recap coordinate bond from the viewpoint of Lewis concept of acids and bases.
lessons.assignments: Readings Section 4, Chapter 4.2-4.5 Solve Section 4 Problem set 4.1-4.6.

lessons.content: Chelatometric titration (2) - Complex titration with EDTA Redox titration (1) - Oxidation and reduction reactions 4th Exam
lessons.assignments: Readings Section 4, Chapter 4.6-4.9 and Section 5, Chapter 5.1 only. Wrap up problem sets for week 11.

lessons.content: Redox titration (2) - Standard electrode potential - Nernst equation - Redox titration curves
lessons.assignments: Readings Section 5, Chapter 5.2-5.5 Solve Section 5 Problem set 5.2-5.7.

lessons.content: Redox titration (3) - Oxidation-reduction Potential and Redox titrations
lessons.assignments: Readings Section 5, Chapter 5.6-5.9 Solve Section 5 Problem set 5.8-5.11.

lessons.content: Final Exam and Wrap up of the course
lessons.assignments: Wrap up problem sets for week 1 through week 14.
